subject.title: Feishu (and non-Discord channels) should apply sanitizeAssistantVisibleText() on outbound text

question: Should this umbrella be resolved by finishing per-channel `sanitizeText` hooks for uncovered channels, or by moving assistant-visible sanitization into a shared outbound delivery boundary?
rationale: Both shapes can fix the leak, but the shared boundary changes owner behavior for every channel while per-channel hooks risk future drift; that tradeoff needs maintainer intent before new automation opens another fix PR.

options.title: Complete per-channel hooks
options.body: Land or repair the open MSTeams and Mattermost slices, audit the remaining outbound adapters, and keep channel-specific formatting control local.

options.title: Centralize delivery sanitization
options.body: Move assistant-visible sanitization into shared outbound delivery with explicit skip/opt-out behavior and broad preservation tests before closing channel slices.

options.title: Narrow this to Feishu
options.body: Close this umbrella only after maintainers intentionally decide that remaining channels should be tracked solely by their own issues or PRs.

recommendation.title: Complete per-channel hooks
recommendation.body: Land or repair the open MSTeams and Mattermost slices, audit the remaining outbound adapters, and keep channel-specific formatting control local.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the newly merged Feishu slice and the open Mattermost slice, making them the closest current routing candidate from available history.
